title: Budget tool response
description: JSON output of `llm-proxy plugin run ibmbob budget`. Always emitted to stdout regardless of success or failure. Discriminated by the presence of the "error" field.

oneOf.title: BudgetResponse
oneOf.description: Successful budget fetch. The configured team's current spend and limit.

currency.description: Unit in which max_budget, spend, and remaining are expressed. Omitted when the upstream does not report one.

max_budget.description: Configured spending ceiling in currency units. 0 when the account is unlimited or the ceiling is unknown — inspect "unlimited" to distinguish the two cases.

spend.description: Cumulative amount consumed so far in currency units.

remaining.description: Convenience field: max_budget minus spend. 0 when max_budget is 0 (unlimited or unknown).

unlimited.description: True when the upstream explicitly marks this account as having no spending ceiling. When true, max_budget and remaining are both 0. Omitted when false.

extras.description: Provider-specific supplemental fields. Omitted when empty.

oneOf.title: BudgetErrorResponse
oneOf.description: Failed budget fetch. Emitted to stdout so the output is always parseable JSON even on error.

error.description: Human-readable error message describing why the budget could not be fetched.
